source.printedPageMapping: Printed pp.1–128 map to PDF pp.2–129; PDF1 and PDF130 are unprinted covers.

scope.ownedRangeDescription: Printed pp.100–109 spell-casting/adventuring/combat procedures; Appendix I Psionics pp.110–117; Appendix II Bards pp.117–118; Appendix III Character Alignment Graph p.119; Appendix IV Known Planes pp.120–121; and in-range Appendix V p.122 plus Reference Sheets pp.123–126 and advertising pp.127–128. Appendix V and reference pages are included because they fall in the delegated continuous pp.118–128 range and contain static rule/reference content.
scope.boundary: Page cohort classification is closed for the inspected content units. Static psionics, Bard, planes and treasure rules are in the product rules scope; absence is not treated as exclusion. Advertising is excluded by content kind.

method.pixelReview: Original PDF page images rendered at 216 dpi. Each page was delivered one image per result and visually inspected; OCR/text extraction was used only for navigation/row discovery, not as proof. Pages 108 and 128 have no visible printed folio and were mapped by the inherited PDF-to-print offset.
method.siteJoin: Frozen 1,000-owner snapshot: each included owner record has captured rendered detail DOM and public-search document. DOM/search evidence establishes the current captured surface only. Search ranking/click-through and live source-chip behavior were not tested; snapshot capture.sourceViewerOpened=false.
method.wholeBookLimit: This is a closed cohort review, not a whole-PHB audit. It classifies source units in scope, not every PHB entry or every field/value.

appendixI.countInterpretation: The 24/20 catalog counts are printed option rows, not counts of distinct named powers. Two minor rows and two major rows instruct rerolling; the major list includes two Telepathic Projection entries.

spellLists.countCaveat: The count equality is not cell-by-cell membership evidence; special eligible-spell list on p.100 is counted as a list unit, not as 20 new spell-profile descriptions.
